title: Official document registry entry
description: One target or acquired official document. Registration records intent to acquire and is not a claim the document was read. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/official/test_official_knowledge.py (D-0006).

url_basis.description: How the URL was obtained. Required, because an inferred URL is not a fact.

expected_content.description: Which facts this document is expected to settle. An expectation about scope, not about content.

response.description: Verbatim. Paraphrasing a failure loses the diagnostic detail that made it worth recording.

invariants: retrieval_status == RETRIEVED  =>  local_path, sha256 and retrieved_on are all non-null
retrieval_status != RETRIEVED  =>  blocked_reason is non-empty AND at least one attempt is recorded, OR retrieval_status == NOT_ATTEMPTED
url_status == INFERRED_UNVERIFIED  =>  no fact may cite this document until a retrieval confirms the URL
a mirror of an official document hosted elsewhere is never registered here; it cannot be hashed against the publisher
